overview.description: The abrdn Physical Palladium Shares ETF (PALL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Disc. Palladium London PM Fix index. The fund tracks the palladium spot price, less trust expenses. PALL was launched on Jan 6, 2010 and is issued by aberdeen.
